blocks.text: a person who ..., a thing that ... — aniqlovchi ergash gap

Aniqlovchi ergash gap (relative clause) otga ta'rif beradi — **qaysi** odam, **qaysi** narsa ekanini aytadi. O'zbek tilida bunday ta'rif sifatdosh bilan yasaladi va otdan **oldin** turadi: «Londonda **ishlaydigan** do'stim», «aeroportga **boradigan** avtobus». Ingliz tilida hammasi teskari: ot **oldin**, ta'rif **keyin**, ular **who** / **which** / **that** so'zi bilan bog'lanadi: a friend **who works** in London, the bus **that goes** to the airport. Ta'rif ichidagi fe'l oddiy to'liq fe'l bo'lib qoladi (works, goes, lived) — «`-digan`» kabi qo'shimcha yo'q.

rows: the bus **that goes to the airport**

blocks.text: Ikki gapdan bitta gap yasash yo'li: I have a friend. **She** lives in London. → I have a friend **who** lives in London. **who** ikkinchi gapdagi **she** ning o'rnini egallaydi — shuning uchun **she** endi yozilmaydi («a friend who she lives» — xato). Bu darsda **who** / **that** ta'rif ichida **ega** vazifasida keladi: harakatni uning o'zi bajaradi (who **works**, that **goes**).

Odam haqida gapirganda **who** ishlatiladi: a man **who**, the girl **who**, people **who**, someone **who**. Kasb va so'zlarni tushuntirishda juda qulay: A pilot is a person **who** flies planes — Uchuvchi — samolyot **boshqaradigan** odam. Odamlar uchun so'zlashuvda **that** ham ishlatiladi, lekin **who** ko'proq uchraydi.

items.text: A baker is someone **who makes** bread.
The man **who lives** upstairs is very noisy.
I know a girl **who speaks** five languages.

blocks.text: which / that — narsa va hayvonlar uchun

Narsa, hayvon, joy haqida **which** yoki **that** ishlatiladi: the book **which** / **that** ..., a dog **that** ... So'zlashuvda **that** ko'proq, yozma matnda **which** ham ko'p uchraydi. Odam uchun **which** ishlatilmaydi («the man which» — xato), narsa uchun **who** ishlatilmaydi («the car who» — xato). **that** esa ikkalasiga ham mos — ikkilansangiz, **that** ni tanlang.

rows: the doctor **that** helped me / the shop **that** sells shoes

items.text: This is the road **that goes** to Samarkand.
We have a cat **which sleeps** all day.

blocks.text: **who** / **that** dan keyingi fe'l o'zidan oldingi **otga** moslashadi: a woman who **works** (bitta → `-s`), people who **work** (ko'p → `-s` siz). Zamon har xil bo'lishi mumkin: o'tgan (who **lived**), davomli (who **is waiting**), Present Perfect (who **has finished**), modal (who **can swim**). O'zbekchadagi «`-adigan`», «`-yotgan`», «`-gan`» farqi inglizchada zamon orqali beriladi.

rows: the man who **sells** fruit — meva **sotadigan** odam
the man who **is selling** fruit — meva **sotayotgan** odam
the man who **sold** me fruit — menga meva **sotgan** odam
the man who **can** fix it — uni **tuzata oladigan** odam

blocks.text: Ta'rif gapning egasiga tegishli bo'lsa, u ega bilan kesim orasiga tushadi: The woman **who lives next door** is a doctor. Bunday gapni o'qiganda chalkashmaslik uchun ta'rifni xayolan qavsga oling: The woman (who lives next door) **is** a doctor — asosiy kesim **is**. O'zbekchada: «Qo'shni uyda yashaydigan ayol — shifokor».

items.text: The bus **that goes** to the centre is always full.

items.translation: Muntazam **sport bilan shug'ullanadigan** odamlar yaxshiroq uxlaydi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I have a friend who **he** lives in London.» → who lives (**who** ning o'zi ega, **he** ortiqcha); «the man **which** ...» → the man **who** ...; «the book **what** ...» → the book **that** / **which** ... (**what** bu yerda ishlatilmaydi); «people who **lives** ...» → people who **live**; o'zbekcha tartibda «the in London living friend» deb bo'lmaydi → a friend **who lives** in London.

O'zbekchadan tarjima qilish usuli: 1) «`-gan` / `-digan` / `-yotgan`» li ta'rifdan keyingi **otni** toping va uni birinchi qo'ying; 2) **who** (odam) yoki **that** (narsa) qo'shing; 3) ta'rifni oddiy gap kabi davom ettiring. «Kecha kelgan **mehmonlar**» → the **guests** + **who** + came yesterday.

Keyingi dars (102): who / that **to'ldiruvchi** bo'lganda — the people (who) **we met**, the hotel **we stayed at** — bunda who / that tushib qolishi mumkin. Bu darsda esa who / that **ega**, uni tashlab bo'lmaydi: the man **who** called me.

examples.title: **who**: people and what they do
examples.description: Odamlarga ta'rif: kasb, xususiyat. O'zbekchada ta'rif otdan oldin («samolyot **boshqaradigan** odam»), inglizchada — keyin (a person **who flies** planes).

sentences.text: A pilot is a person **who flies** planes.
sentences.translation: Uchuvchi — samolyot **boshqaradigan** odam.

sentences.text: Dentists are doctors **who look after** your teeth.
sentences.translation: Tish shifokorlari — tishlarimizni **davolaydigan** shifokorlar.

sentences.text: An architect is someone **who designs** buildings.
sentences.translation: Arxitektor — binolarni **loyihalaydigan** kishi.

sentences.text: A tour guide is a person **who shows** tourists around a city.
sentences.translation: Gid — sayyohlarga shaharni **aylantirib ko'rsatadigan** odam.

sentences.text: People **who live** in Tashkent often go to the mountains at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda **yashaydigan** odamlar dam olish kunlari tez-tez tog'ga chiqishadi.

sentences.text: A vegetarian is someone **who doesn't eat** meat.
sentences.translation: Vegetarian — go'sht **yemaydigan** odam.

sentences.text: Students **who study** hard usually get good results.
sentences.translation: Qunt bilan **o'qiydigan** talabalar odatda yaxshi natijaga erishadi.

sentences.text: Is there anyone here **who speaks** Russian?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda ruscha **gapiradigan** biror kishi bormi?

sentences.text: Children **who read** a lot usually have a good imagination.
sentences.translation: Ko'p kitob **o'qiydigan** bolalarning tasavvuri odatda boy bo'ladi.

sentences.text: My aunt is a nurse **who works** at night.
sentences.translation: Xolam — tunda **ishlaydigan** hamshira.

examples.title: **who** in everyday life
examples.description: **who** dan keyin har xil zamon: who **lives** («yashaydigan»), who **sat** («o'tirgan»), who **were travelling** («sayohat qilayotgan»), who **can teach** («o'rgata oladigan»).

sentences.text: I've got a friend **who lives** in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Manchesterda **yashaydigan** do'stim bor.

sentences.text: Do you remember the boy **who sat** next to me at school?
sentences.translation: Maktabda yonimda **o'tirgan** bolani eslaysanmi?

sentences.text: Aziz is the man **who helped** us with our luggage.
sentences.translation: Aziz — yuklarimizni ko'tarishga **yordam bergan** odam.

sentences.text: We met a couple from Oxford **who were travelling** around Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: O'zbekiston bo'ylab **sayohat qilayotgan** oksfordlik er-xotin bilan tanishdik.

sentences.text: I don't like people **who are** rude to waiters.
sentences.translation: Ofitsiantlarga **qo'pollik qiladigan** odamlarni yoqtirmayman.

sentences.text: Madina has a brother **who plays** football for a team in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Madinaning Buxorodagi jamoada futbol **o'ynaydigan** akasi bor.

sentences.text: That's the doctor **who's treating** my grandmother.
sentences.translation: Ana u — buvimni **davolayotgan** shifokor.

sentences.text: Thank you to everyone **who came** to my birthday party!
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kunimga **kelgan** hammaga rahmat!

sentences.text: There's a man at the door **who wants** to speak to you.
sentences.translation: Eshik oldida siz bilan **gaplashmoqchi bo'lgan** bir kishi turibdi.

sentences.text: James is looking for someone **who can teach** him Uzbek.
sentences.translation: Jeyms o'ziga o'zbek tilini **o'rgata oladigan** odam qidiryapti.

examples.title: **which** / **that**: things and animals
examples.description: Narsa va hayvonlar uchun **which** yoki **that** (so'zlashuvda **that** ko'proq). **who** narsalar uchun ishlatilmaydi.

sentences.text: This is the bus **that goes** to the airport.
sentences.translation: Bu aeroportga **boradigan** avtobus.

sentences.text: I need a bag **which is** big enough for my laptop.
sentences.translation: Menga noutbukim **sig'adigan** sumka kerak.

sentences.text: Where are the photos **that were** on the table?
sentences.translation: Stol ustida **turgan** suratlar qayerda?

sentences.text: Samarkand has buildings **which are** more than six hundred years old.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda **olti yuz yoshdan oshgan** binolar bor.

sentences.text: We stayed in a hotel **that had** a swimming pool on the roof.
sentences.translation: Tomida basseyni **bo'lgan** mehmonxonada to'xtadik.

sentences.text: A dictionary is a book **that gives** the meanings of words.
sentences.translation: Lug'at — so'zlarning ma'nosini **beradigan** kitob.

sentences.text: Have you got a charger **that works** with this phone?
sentences.translation: Sizda shu telefonga **to'g'ri keladigan** quvvatlagich bormi?

sentences.text: Emma has a dog **which barks** at everyone.
sentences.translation: Emmaning hammaga **akillaydigan** iti bor.

sentences.text: It's a film **that makes** everybody laugh.
sentences.translation: Bu hammani **kuldiradigan** film.

sentences.text: Tom works for a company **which sells** furniture online.
sentences.translation: Tom internetda mebel **sotadigan** kompaniyada ishlaydi.

examples.title: In the middle: The man **who lives** next door is ...
examples.description: Ta'rif gapning egasiga tegishli bo'lsa, ega bilan kesim orasida turadi. Asosiy kesim ta'rifdan keyin keladi: The man (who lives next door) **is** ...

sentences.text: The man **who lives** next door is a famous singer.
sentences.translation: Qo'shni uyda **yashaydigan** kishi — mashhur xonanda.

sentences.text: Trains **that leave** before seven are usually cheaper.
sentences.translation: Soat yettidan oldin **jo'naydigan** poyezdlar odatda arzonroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: The woman **who called** you this morning didn't leave her name.
sentences.translation: Bugun ertalab sizga **qo'ng'iroq qilgan** ayol ismini aytmadi.

sentences.text: People **who smoke** often have problems with their health.
sentences.translation: **Chekadigan** odamlarning sog'lig'ida ko'pincha muammo bo'ladi.

sentences.text: My cousin **who works** in London is visiting us next month.
sentences.translation: Londonda **ishlaydigan** amakivachcham kelasi oy bizga mehmon bo'lib keladi.

sentences.text: Everybody **who came** to the meeting got a free notebook.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishga **kelgan** har bir kishi bepul daftar oldi.

sentences.text: The keys **that were** on the shelf have disappeared.
sentences.translation: Tokchada **turgan** kalitlar yo'qolib qolibdi.

sentences.text: A girl **who was** in my class at school is now a famous actress.
sentences.translation: Men bilan bir sinfda **o'qigan** qiz hozir mashhur aktrisa.

sentences.text: Anyone **who wants** a ticket should call Mr Smith.
sentences.translation: Chipta **olmoqchi bo'lgan** har bir kishi janob Smitga qo'ng'iroq qilsin.

sentences.text: Restaurants **which serve** traditional Uzbek food are very popular with tourists.
sentences.translation: An'anaviy o'zbek taomlarini **tayyorlaydigan** restoranlar sayyohlar orasida juda mashhur.

examples.title: Questions: Do you know anyone **who** ...?
examples.description: Savol-javob: savolda ham ta'rif otdan keyin keladi. O'zbekchada esa savolda ham ta'rif oldin: «Yaponcha **gapiradigan** biror kishini bilasanmi?»

sentences.text: Do you know anyone **who speaks** Japanese? — Yes, my neighbour does.
sentences.translation: Yaponcha **gapiradigan** biror kishini bilasanmi? — Ha, qo'shnim gapiradi.

sentences.text: Who's the man **who's standing** by the window? — That's our new boss.
sentences.translation: Deraza yonida **turgan** odam kim? — U yangi rahbarimiz.

sentences.text: Is there a bus **that goes** to Chorsu Bazaar? — Yes, the number 46.
sentences.translation: Chorsu bozoriga **boradigan** avtobus bormi? — Ha, 46-avtobus.

sentences.text: What's the name of the shop **that sells** second-hand books? — I can't remember.
sentences.translation: Ishlatilgan kitoblar **sotadigan** do'konning nomi nima edi? — Esimda yo'q.

sentences.text: Have you got a friend **who can repair** computers? — Bekzod can.
sentences.translation: Kompyuter **tuzata oladigan** do'sting bormi? — Bekzod tuzata oladi.

sentences.text: Where's the cake **that was** in the fridge? — Sorry, I ate it!
sentences.translation: Muzlatgichda **turgan** tort qani? — Kechirasan, yeb qo'ydim!

sentences.text: Who was the girl **who won** the singing competition? — Dilnoza's sister.
sentences.translation: Qo'shiq tanlovida **g'olib bo'lgan** qiz kim edi? — Dilnozaning singlisi.

sentences.text: Do you like films **that have** sad endings? — No, I prefer comedies.
sentences.translation: Oxiri qayg'uli **tugaydigan** filmlarni yoqtirasizmi? — Yo'q, komediyalarni afzal ko'raman.

sentences.text: Is this the train **that stops** in Samarkand? — No, that one's on platform 2.
sentences.translation: Samarqandda **to'xtaydigan** poyezd shumi? — Yo'q, u 2-platformada.

sentences.text: Was it you **who left** the door open? — No, it wasn't me.
sentences.translation: Eshikni ochiq **qoldirgan** sizmidingiz? — Yo'q, men emas.

examples.title: Negative and past: who **didn't**, that **doesn't**
examples.description: Ta'rif ichida inkor va o'tgan zamon: who **didn't do** («bajarmagan»), that **don't hurt** («qismaydigan»). Tasdiq va inkor yonma-yon.

sentences.text: Students **who did** their homework got good marks.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifasini **bajargan** o'quvchilar yaxshi baho oldi.

sentences.text: Students **who didn't do** their homework had to stay after class.
sentences.translation: Uy vazifasini **bajarmagan** o'quvchilar darsdan keyin qolishga majbur bo'ldi.

sentences.text: I prefer shoes **that don't hurt** my feet.
sentences.translation: Oyog'imni **qismaydigan** poyabzalni afzal ko'raman.

sentences.text: We threw away all the food **that wasn't** fresh.
sentences.translation: **Yangi bo'lmagan** hamma ovqatni tashlab yubordik.

sentences.text: There are still many villages **which don't have** good roads.
sentences.translation: Hali ham yaxshi yo'li **bo'lmagan** qishloqlar ko'p.

sentences.text: It's hard to work with people **who never listen**.
sentences.translation: Hech qachon **quloq solmaydigan** odamlar bilan ishlash qiyin.

sentences.text: The clock **that stopped** last week is working again.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta **to'xtab qolgan** soat yana yuryapti.

sentences.text: Sarah bought a laptop **that didn't work**, so she took it back.
sentences.translation: Sara **ishlamaydigan** noutbuk sotib olib qo'ydi, shuning uchun uni qaytarib berdi.

sentences.text: Passengers **who haven't got** a ticket must buy one from the driver.
sentences.translation: Chiptasi **yo'q** yo'lovchilar haydovchidan chipta sotib olishi shart.

sentences.text: My grandfather was a man **who never complained** about anything.
sentences.translation: Bobom hech narsadan **nolimaydigan** odam edi.

examples.title: **who** or **which**? People and things
examples.description: Juftliklar: odam — **who**, narsa — **which** / **that**. Ikkalasiga ham mos keladigan so'z — **that**.

sentences.text: I met a woman **who makes** beautiful carpets.
sentences.translation: Chiroyli gilamlar **to'qiydigan** ayol bilan tanishdim.

sentences.text: Tom works in a factory **which makes** carpets.
sentences.translation: Tom gilam **ishlab chiqaradigan** fabrikada ishlaydi.

sentences.text: We need someone **who can drive**.
sentences.translation: Bizga mashina **hayday oladigan** odam kerak.

sentences.text: We need a car **that can carry** six people.
sentences.translation: Bizga olti kishini **sig'dira oladigan** mashina kerak.

sentences.text: The doctor **who saw** me was very kind.
sentences.translation: Meni **ko'rgan** shifokor juda mehribon edi.

sentences.text: The medicine **that helped** me most was very cheap.
sentences.translation: Menga eng ko'p **yordam bergan** dori juda arzon edi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza has a teacher **who gives** too much homework.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning juda ko'p uy vazifasi **beradigan** o'qituvchisi bor.

sentences.text: This is an app **that gives** you new English words every day.
sentences.translation: Bu har kuni yangi inglizcha so'zlar **beradigan** ilova.

sentences.text: Anyone **who loves** animals will enjoy this film.
sentences.translation: Hayvonlarni **yaxshi ko'radigan** har bir kishiga bu film yoqadi.

sentences.text: Our town has a zoo **which has** animals from all over the world.
sentences.translation: Shahrimizda butun dunyodan keltirilgan hayvonlar **saqlanadigan** hayvonot bog'i bor.

examples.title: Dialogue: who's who at the party
examples.description: Ziyofatda kim kimligini so'rash: **who**, **which**, **that** jonli suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Who's the woman **who's talking** to your brother?
sentences.translation: — Akang bilan **gaplashayotgan** ayol kim?

sentences.text: — That's Sarah. She's the teacher **who taught** me English.
sentences.translation: — Bu Sara. Menga ingliz tilini **o'rgatgan** o'qituvchi shu.

sentences.text: — Really? And the man **who's wearing** the blue shirt?
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? Ko'k ko'ylak **kiygan** erkak-chi?

sentences.text: — That's her husband. He's a chef **who works** at a hotel in the centre.
sentences.translation: — U uning eri. Markazdagi mehmonxonada **ishlaydigan** oshpaz.

sentences.text: — Is that the hotel **that won** a prize last year?
sentences.translation: — O'tgan yili mukofot **olgan** mehmonxona o'shami?

sentences.text: — Yes. It's the place **which has** the best plov in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: — Ha. Toshkentdagi eng mazali palov **pishiriladigan** joy.

sentences.text: — I love people **who can** cook well!
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi ovqat **pishira oladigan** odamlarni yaxshi ko'raman!

sentences.text: — Then come and meet Madina — she's the girl **who made** this cake.
sentences.translation: — Unda kel, Madina bilan tanishtiraman — bu tortni **pishirgan** qiz shu.

sentences.text: — The cake **that's** on the big table? It looks delicious!
sentences.translation: — Katta stol ustida **turgan** tortmi? Juda mazali ko'rinyapti!

sentences.text: — Yes, and it's the last piece **that's** left, so be quick!
sentences.translation: — Ha, bu **qolgan** oxirgi bo'lak, tezroq bo'l!
